# Digital Web Weaver

> A senior engineering studio building high-performance web platforms, SaaS products, mobile apps, and AI systems since 2013. Headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat, India, working with clients across India, the UK, and South Africa.

Digital Web Weaver is a senior-only engineering team (no juniors) delivering custom software development, a catalog of pre-built SaaS products, and dedicated-resource hiring. Founded 2013.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://digitalwebweaver.com/web-development/): Marketing sites to complex web applications
- [Custom Web Apps](https://digitalwebweaver.com/custom-web-apps/): Portals, dashboards, internal tools
- [E-Commerce Development](https://digitalwebweaver.com/ecommerce-development/): Storefronts built to convert
- [UI/UX Design](https://digitalwebweaver.com/ui-ux-design/): Research, systems, prototypes
- [Mobile App Development](https://digitalwebweaver.com/mobile-app-development/): Native iOS, Android, cross-platform
- [AI & Automation](https://digitalwebweaver.com/ai-automation/): LLM features and workflow automation
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://digitalwebweaver.com/cloud-devops/): CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, uptime
- [Custom Software Development](https://digitalwebweaver.com/custom-software-development/): Bespoke ERP, CRM, and portals
- [MVP Development](https://digitalwebweaver.com/mvp-development/): Validate an idea in weeks
- [SaaS Development](https://digitalwebweaver.com/saas-development/): Multi-tenant, billing, growth-ready products
- [CRM & ERP Systems](https://digitalwebweaver.com/crm-erp-systems/): Business systems fit to real operations
- [Hire Dedicated Resource](https://digitalwebweaver.com/hire-dedicated-resource/): Senior engineers embedded with your team

## Products

Digital Web Weaver also builds and sells pre-built SaaS products for specific industries — full catalog at [/products/](https://digitalwebweaver.com/products/), including [GlowDesk](https://digitalwebweaver.com/glowdesk/) (aesthetic clinic booking), [ClinicFlow](https://digitalwebweaver.com/clinicflow/) (clinic management), [SchoolHub](https://digitalwebweaver.com/schoolhub/) (school administration), [SolarFlow](https://digitalwebweaver.com/solarflow/) (solar installer ERP), and [EduCore](https://digitalwebweaver.com/educore/) (LMS).
